name: ELLIO_reputation
author: Luca Memini
description: Query ELLIO for IP reputation: Threat Intelligence (CTI lookup: seen status, classification, actor, tags), reverse DNS (PTR records) and Common Business Services classification (cloud providers, CDNs, SaaS). Each service can be enabled or disabled independently.

configurationItems.name: api_key
configurationItems.description: ELLIO API key (sent as X-API-Key header)

configurationItems.name: enable_cti
configurationItems.description: Query the CTI lookup service (requires an active CTI plan)

configurationItems.name: enable_rdns
configurationItems.description: Query the rDNS service (requires an rDNS plan, or a CTI plan with API access)

configurationItems.name: enable_cbs
configurationItems.description: Query the Common Business Services lookup (requires an active CTI or blocklist plan)
